description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Gaz.Ex.Ord. No. 1395/15 of 01.06.2005 adding Faculty of Technological Studies, Uva-Wellassa University of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to a university's structure under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory authority (Section 27(1)) that modifies the schedule of an existing order, which constitutes subsidiary legislation. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending the legal framework governing the university's faculties and departments rather than detailing the minister's portfolio responsibilities or making personnel appointments.
